note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 4724 Section 4.2 ('"Acting accordingly" in this context means that the previous TCP session MUST be closed, and the new one retained.') after lint cleanup in rfc4724_collision_test.go (d3fcd1cfd7: dropped unused third return from setupEstablishedGRSession and used !errors.Is(res.err, io.EOF)). Producers finishCollisionHandoff and peerAdvertisedGRFamilies are unchanged. Positive subtest proves finishCollisionHandoff on an Established session with received GR families closes the old TCP socket with 0 bytes / io.EOF (no NOTIFICATION) while retaining the new connection in peer.inbound and keeping it readable/writable (1-byte probe succeeds). Negative subtest without GR families proves the new connection receives NOTIFICATION Cease/Connection Collision (6/7) while oldSession.Conn() remains non-nil.
